wheel_measurement.basis: uncalibrated sensitivity assumptions, not a hardware sensor claim

analysis.unit: one independent native seed per physical context and cohort
analysis.primary_score: max over three wheels of absolute log response-gain deviation from healthy calibration median, divided by max(healthy median absolute deviation, 0.01)
analysis.response_gain: for each wheel, sum absolute consecutive valid speed differences divided by sum absolute FSW command times source-time delta, over pairs with later source time >=2.8s and <=17.6s; require total command-time effort >=0.001 Nms and >=10 valid pairs; use log(gain+1e-6)
analysis.calibration: per initial-state and reference mode, pool all three nominal target-wheel design levels; fit wheel-channel median and median absolute deviation from 90 healthy calibration cases only; target-wheel identity is not a model input
analysis.threshold: per initial-state and reference mode, nearest-rank 90th percentile of 90 healthy calibration case scores; score > threshold is positive
analysis.abstain: missing gain for any wheel, missing calibration, or nonfinite values; include abstentions in denominators and report separately; no fault label imputation
analysis.primary_comparison: held-out healthy positive rate versus loss50 and loss75 positive rates, separately for 18 contexts and pooled with exact numerators
analysis.secondary: zero versus pulse09x4 reported separately; no post-hoc threshold or feature selection
